announcements.title: Term 2 Kick-off: Start-up Leader Session
announcements.body:
We're kicking off Term 2 with our first Start-up Leader Session on Wednesday, 21st October.
To be eligible to attend the session, you must:
• Opt in to the session.
• Complete and submit the pre-work — a one-pager answering the questions provided in the case.
📌 Deadline for both opt-in and pre-work submission: Tuesday, 20th October, 5 PM.
